title: Crashes for a customer who does not exist
plain: The new code reads the customer's name straight away. But find_customer returns None when there is no such customer, and you cannot read a name out of None. That is defined in customers.py.
diff:
--- a/service.py
+++ b/service.py
@@ -67,6 +67,13 @@
     ))
 
 
+@app.get("/greeting/{customer_id}")
+def greeting(customer_id: int):
+    """Greet the customer by name."""
+    customer = find_customer(customer_id)
+    return {"hello": customer["name"]}
